title: anthericum saltii var. oatesii
intro: Anthericum saltii var. oatesii, commonly known as Oat Lily or White Anthericum, is a flowering plant species in the family Asparagaceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Anthericum saltii var. oatesii include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and swelling, and promoting skin health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include astringent, expectorant, and emollient effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoids and saponins.
